title: Stack Profile Matrix Schema
description: Schema for Vibe Coding OS stack profile matrix — maps technology stack features to recommended model profiles and quality pack overrides.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of this matrix.

tech_stacks.description: Array of technology stack entries, each defining framework, language, database, and recommended model profile.

techStackEntry.description: Defines a technology stack combination with model profile hints and optional quality pack overrides.

id.description: Unique identifier for this stack entry.

framework.description: Technology framework name. Use 'any' if framework-agnostic.

database.description: Primary database technology. Use 'any' or empty string if not applicable.

profile_hint.description: Recommended quality engine profile for this stack combination.

quality_pack_overrides.description: Optional per-task-type overrides to quality pack IDs for this stack entry.
